questions.q: The candela is the SI base unit of which quantity?
questions.explain: Candela (cd) is one of the seven SI base units. It measures luminous intensity.
questions.voice_q: The candela is the S I base unit of which quantity?
questions.voice_a: The answer is B, luminous intensity. The candela is one of the seven S I base units.

questions.q: Which of these is a dimensionless quantity?
questions.explain: Strain = change in length ÷ original length. Length cancels length, so it has no dimensions.
questions.voice_q: Which of these is a dimensionless quantity?
questions.voice_a: The answer is A, strain. It is change in length divided by original length, so the dimensions cancel out.

questions.q: The dimensional formula of pressure is:
questions.explain: Pressure = Force ÷ Area = [M L T⁻²] ÷ [L²] = [M L⁻¹ T⁻²].
questions.voice_q: The dimensional formula of pressure is?
questions.voice_a: The answer is A. Pressure is force over area, which gives M L to the power minus one, T to the power minus two.
